desc.en: An elder dragon that has lived for countless years. It can understand human language, and while it possesses the intelligence to converse with humans, ultimately the only form of communication it seems to understand is combat.
desc.ja: 長い年月を生きてきた老竜。人の言葉を理解し、意思疎通が可能なほど知性も高いが、残念ながら戦い以外の方法では対話は不可能
